rationale: Y has a more distinctive hero (expressive italic accent headline, tilted progress report with stamp and skill bars over a live class UI), a warmer terracotta/navy/ochre palette, and more varied, specific feature illustrations (script tiles, timezone clock, pitch contour). X is clean and cohesive with a strong serif and a good class mock, but its green-and-cream palette, uniform icon cards and stacked sections feel more like a polished template, and its hero report card is cropped at the fold.
